_comment: Which properties send money-out and deposit signals. MORRIS first, proven end to end, then expand. Adding a property here without seeding its payee map and its property-specific 1xxx account map will auto-create vendor records and throw unmapped-account errors — see PROPERA_GRAND_FINANCIAL_PARITY.md and propera-v2/docs/PROPERA_FINANCE_PROPERTY_CASH.md. bank_batch_from must match property_bank_accounts.cash_live_from — End-Batch# signals only from that date forward; V2 also enforces cash_live_from on the actor path.
